description: Topological publish order for clawql-* workspace packages. Publish each row before the next; clawql-mcp is last.
notes: mcp-grpc-transport, mcp-api-adapter, and panguard-mcp-bridge publish on their own cadence.
localPackExtras are packed/installed in CI npm-pack smoke so clawql-mcp can resolve unpublished peer versions (e.g. mcp-grpc-transport@1.0.0 before registry publish).
mcp-api-adapter depends on mcp-grpc-transport — pack/publish transport first.
clawql-merkle is zero-dep integrity (Merkle + hash-chain); publish before clawql-core.
clawql-telemetry is not yet a package (see #313).
clawql-ontology has no clawql-* deps (ajv/yaml only) — safe early in the order.
clawql-web before clawql-documents (documents depends on web for IDP URL fetch).
clawql-payments before clawql-inference (inference depends on payments for entitlements/credits).
clawql-harness after clawql-ouroboros (Ouroboros harness plugin imports convergence patterns).
clawql-tee after clawql-auth (TEE signing bridge depends on IdJagAssertionSigner types).
npm publish replaces workspace:* with concrete versions in published package.json.
Monorepo dev uses matching 7.2.0 semver; npm workspaces link packages locally.
